notes.title: Update! New tournament system! Leagues!
notes.notes:
⚔ Good day, commanders! ⚔

We are pleased to announce the new update:

✅ Grandiose changes in the "tournament system"! 🏆
The new distribution of tournament places will be based on the experience of the Players and will be divided into three types:
1) Golden League 🥇
2) Silver League 🥈
3) Bronze League 🥉

Now each player will have more chances to win a prize in his league, and the total award fund will be distributed more equitably! 👍
Players who played «Metal Force» are already familiar with this system 😎

A little later, we will do a post about "FAQ related to the League", and also answer your questions in the comments!

notes.title: 💥 The update is finally here! 💥
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31912977/5e7c83f5859a2181861c9c7f3cb0c1bb719c8116.jpg[/img]We glad to submit our new update and ready to show you all that we worked for all this time.

The update will be available on main platforms during an hour. Platforms Amazon and MAC, also UWP, can delay the update - the process of approving is last longer and closely. Please, be patient.

⚡ Well, what is changed in this update? ⚡

* Participate in the battles for strategic location - The new map is waiting for you!
* New Daily Battle Tasks are available in the game!
* You can chat with friends in separate chat!
* Great amount of important changes.
* Comprehensive bug fixes.

⚠ If you faced any technical problem we urged recommend you to connect with our support team. The sooner we take the information, the sooner we'll can to take the necessary steps.

Hurry to try new functional and leave your opinion here!
